items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: They got T-Boy Rene and me play trumpet too

ctx.x: Yeah, I've heard the name too. No, that's... I'm thinking of a bass band.
No, T-Boy's a bass player. They got T-Boy Rene and me play trumpet too, you know. Yeah, then they got a T-Boy, I believe he was playing bands with Kid Rene too.
